delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: hello, how may i help you today?

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: hello, i would like to check the status of my order as the payment method seems to be wrong

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: i see, you wish to check the status of payment on your order because you believe it to be wrong, i can help with that today

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: first i need your full name to pull up your account

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: i also need your account id

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: joyce wu

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: and order id

delexed.speaker: action
delexed.text: account has been pulled up for joyce wu.

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: thank you

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: in order to pull up the shipment i now need the account and order id

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: <account_id>,  <order_id>

delexed.speaker: action
delexed.text: identity verification in progress ...

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: thank you, and what is the current shipping status?

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: in transit

delexed.speaker: action
delexed.text: shipping status of in transit has been noted.

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: we can change the payment method immediately

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: great

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: what would you like the new method to be?

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: debit card please

delexed.speaker: action
delexed.text: order has been updated with debit card.

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: ok, i have updated your order to be paid with the debit card on file, is there anything else i can assist with today?

delexed.speaker: customer
delexed.text: that is all thank you very much

delexed.speaker: agent
delexed.text: thanks, have a good one!
